whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm requirements.txt no longer carries a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
